shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's moves have 10% more power for each fainted ally, up to 5 allies.
shortDesc.zhHans: 我方每有一只宝可梦陷入过濒死，招式威力提升10%。最多触发5次

shortDesc.en: If Electric Terrain is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.
shortDesc.zhHans: 电气场地下速度翻倍

shortDesc.en: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Bug attacks.
shortDesc.zhHans: 当HP小于1/3时，虫属性招式的威力提升50%

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon and its allies cannot fall asleep; those already asleep do not wake up.
shortDesc.zhHans: 使己方免疫睡眠状态

shortDesc.en: If Rain Dance is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.
shortDesc.zhHans: 在下雨时速度翻倍

shortDesc.en: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Defense multiplied by 0.75.
shortDesc.zhHans: 在场时，除该特性的宝可梦外，其他特性的宝可梦的防御降低为原本的75%

shortDesc.en: If an ally uses its item, this Pokemon gives its item to that ally immediately.
shortDesc.zhHans: 同伴使用道具后会立即将您的道具交给它

shortDesc.en: If another Pokemon burns/poisons/paralyzes this Pokemon, it also gets that status.
shortDesc.zhHans: 如果因对方招式而陷入灼伤/中毒/麻痹状态，对方也同样陷入同样的状态

shortDesc.en: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Attack multiplied by 0.75.
shortDesc.zhHans: 在场时，除该特性的宝可梦外，其他特性的宝可梦的攻击降低为原本的75%

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's evasiveness is doubled as long as it is confused.
shortDesc.zhHans: 混乱状态下闪避率翻倍

shortDesc.en: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Speed lowered by 1 stage.
shortDesc.zhHans: 受到接触伤害时对方速度降低1级

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's moves of 60 power or less have 1.5x power, including Struggle.
shortDesc.zhHans: 使用威力≤60的招式，威力提升50%

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon does not take damage from attacks made by its allies.
shortDesc.zhHans: 不会受到同伴招式的伤害

shortDesc.en: Terapagos: Terastallizing ends the effects of weather and terrain. Once per battle.
shortDesc.zhHans: 令场上所有的天气型状态和场地型状态消失。每场对战仅能发动1次

shortDesc.en: Terapagos: If full HP, attacks taken have 0.5x effectiveness unless naturally immune.
shortDesc.zhHans: HP全满时，如果受到的攻击招式的属性相性倍率为1或以上，将变为效果不好

shortDesc.en: If this Pokemon is a Terapagos, it transforms into its Terastal Form on entry.
shortDesc.zhHans: 出场时会吸收周围的能量，变为太晶形态

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.
shortDesc.zhHans: 招式无视对方特性

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 when damaged by Fire moves; can't be burned.
shortDesc.zhHans: 受到火属性招式攻击时攻击提升1级；不会陷入灼伤状态

shortDesc.en: Fire-/Ice-type moves against this Pokemon deal damage with a halved offensive stat.
shortDesc.zhHans: 受到冰属性或火属性招式攻击时，在伤害计算中对方的攻击或特攻减半。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's attacks that are not very effective on a target deal double damage.
shortDesc.zhHans: 该特性的宝可梦自身发动效果不好的招式伤害翻倍。

shortDesc.en: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Water attacks.
shortDesc.zhHans: 当HP小于1/3时，水属性招式的威力提升50%

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's contact moves have their power multiplied by 1.3.
shortDesc.zhHans: 接触类招式威力提升30%

shortDesc.en: While this Pokemon is poisoned, its physical attacks have 1.5x power.
shortDesc.zhHans: 中毒和剧毒状态下物理招式威力提升50%

shortDesc.en: If this Pokemon is hit by a physical attack, Toxic Spikes are set on the opposing side.
shortDesc.zhHans: 该特性的宝可梦受到物理招式攻击时，会向对手的场地撒下毒菱

shortDesc.en: On switch-in, or when it can, this Pokemon copies a random adjacent foe's Ability.
shortDesc.zhHans: 登场时复制一个随机对方宝可梦的特性

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.3 while using an Electric-type attack.
shortDesc.zhHans: 电属性招式威力提升30%

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.
shortDesc.zhHans: 回复HP的招式优先度+3

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon skips every other turn instead of using a move.
shortDesc.zhHans: 使用招式之后，下一回合不能使用招式

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.
shortDesc.zhHans: 招式无视对方特性

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon ignores other Pokemon's stat stages when taking or doing damage.
shortDesc.zhHans: 使用或受到招式造成伤害时无视对方的能力阶级变化

shortDesc.en: Speed is doubled on held item loss; boost is lost if it switches, gets new item/Ability.
shortDesc.zhHans: 失去道具时速度翻倍，退场或获得新道具后复原

shortDesc.en: While this Pokemon is active, it prevents opposing Pokemon from using their Berries.
shortDesc.zhHans: 对方宝可梦不可使用树果

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore the target's protection, except Max Guard.
shortDesc.zhHans: 使用接触类招式时，能无视对方除极巨防壁外守住类状态的效果

shortDesc.en: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Special Attack multiplied by 0.75.
shortDesc.zhHans: 在场时，除该特性的宝可梦外，其他特性的宝可梦的特攻降低为原本的75%

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon and its allies' moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.1.
shortDesc.zhHans: 场上己方所有宝可梦命中率提升10%

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.
shortDesc.zhHans: 不会陷入睡眠状态，在睡眠状态时获得这个特性可以治愈睡眠

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Electric moves; Electric immunity.
shortDesc.zhHans: 受到电属性招式攻击时回复1/4最大HP；免疫电属性伤害

shortDesc.en: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability swapped with this one.
shortDesc.zhHans: 受到接触类招式攻击时，自己获得攻击方的特性，同时攻击方的特性变为游魂

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Water moves; Water immunity.
shortDesc.zhHans: 受到水属性招式攻击时回复1/4最大HP；免疫水属性伤害

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's Water power is 2x; it can't be burned; Fire power against it is halved.
shortDesc.zhHans: 水属性招式威力翻倍；不会陷入灼伤状态；受到的火属性招式伤害减半

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's Defense is raised 2 stages after it is damaged by a Water-type move.
shortDesc.zhHans: 受到水属性招式攻击时防御提升2级

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.
shortDesc.zhHans: 不会陷入灼伤状态。获得特性时可治愈灼伤状态

shortDesc.en: If a physical attack hits this Pokemon, Defense is lowered by 1, Speed is raised by 2.
shortDesc.zhHans: 受到物理招式伤害时防御降低1级，同时速度提升2级

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's Defense is raised 2 stages if hit by a Fire move; Fire immunity.
shortDesc.zhHans: 受到火属性的招式攻击时，不会受到伤害，而是会提升2级防御

shortDesc.en: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.
shortDesc.zhHans: 不会因为对手的招式或特性而被降低能力

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon switches out when it reaches 1/2 or less of its maximum HP.
shortDesc.zhHans: HP低于50%时自身退场

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon gains the Charge effect when hit by a wind move or Tailwind begins.
shortDesc.zhHans: 受到风的招式攻击或己方使用顺风时，会进入充电状态

shortDesc.en: Attack raised by 1 if hit by a wind move or Tailwind begins. Wind move immunity.
shortDesc.zhHans: 受到风的招式攻击或己方使用顺风时，提升1级攻击。不受风的招式影响。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon can only be damaged by supereffective moves and indirect damage.
shortDesc.zhHans: 只会受到效果绝佳招式的攻击伤害，天气、异常状态、附加伤害效果依然有效

shortDesc.en: Status moves with accuracy checks are 50% accurate when used on this Pokemon.
shortDesc.zhHans: 变化招式对该特性的宝可梦命中率减半

shortDesc.en: If Darmanitan, at end of turn changes Mode to Standard if > 1/2 max HP, else Zen.
shortDesc.zhHans: HP不足一半时转变为达摩形态

shortDesc.en: If this Pokemon is a Palafin in Zero Form, switching out has it change to Hero Form.
shortDesc.zhHans: 回到同行队伍后，会变为全能形态
